title: Convex and Non-Convex Polygons Practice
description: Practice classifying polygons using interior angles, inward dents, and diagonals.

questions.question: Which statement best describes a convex polygon?
options: It has at least one curved side.
It has no inward dent and all interior angles are less than 180 degrees.
It must have exactly five sides.
It has at least one interior angle greater than 180 degrees.
questions.explanation: A convex polygon has no inward dent, and each interior angle is less than 180 degrees.

questions.question: A polygon has one interior angle measuring 215 degrees. How should it be classified?
options: Convex
Non-convex
Regular
Not a polygon
questions.explanation: Any polygon with an interior angle greater than 180 degrees is non-convex.

questions.question: If every diagonal of a polygon stays inside the polygon, the polygon is convex.
questions.explanation: The diagonal test says a convex polygon has all diagonals inside the polygon.

questions.question: Which feature proves that a polygon is non-convex?
options: It has more than four sides.
It has at least one inward dent.
It has equal side lengths.
It has a diagonal.
questions.explanation: An inward dent creates a reflex interior angle, so the polygon is non-convex.

questions.question: A triangle is always convex. Why?
options: A triangle has no diagonals and cannot have an inward dent.
A triangle always has equal sides.
A triangle always has one angle greater than 180 degrees.
A triangle is not a polygon.
questions.explanation: A triangle cannot cave inward while remaining a simple polygon, so it is always convex.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: A non-convex polygon has at least one interior angle greater than ___ degrees.
questions.explanation: A non-convex polygon has at least one reflex interior angle, which is greater than 180 degrees.

questions.question: A hexagon has one corner pushed inward. Classify it and give one reason.
questions.correctAnswer: It is non-convex because it has an inward dent, so at least one interior angle is greater than 180 degrees.
questions.explanation: The inward corner is enough evidence that the hexagon is non-convex.

questions.question: A diagonal from one vertex to another non-adjacent vertex passes outside a polygon. What does this show?
options: The polygon is convex.
The polygon is non-convex.
The polygon has equal angles.
The polygon is regular.
questions.explanation: If at least one diagonal goes outside the polygon, the polygon is non-convex.
